newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MAS plans bonus, rights, bond issues.
newsitem.headline: MAS plans bonus, rights, bond issues.

text.p: Malaysian Airline System Bhd (MAS) said on Sunday it plans a one-for-one bonus issue, a one-for-one rights issue and a 1.5 billion ringgit bond issue.
The national carrier said it would raise 3.271 billion ringgit from the exercise.
The rights shares will be issued at 2.30 ringgit each.
MAS stock closed at 6.40 ringgit on Friday.
The five-year 1.0 percent unsecured bonds will be issued together with 770 million detachable warrants, MAS said.

MAS chairman Tajudin Ramli told a news conference that the cash-raising exercise is to part finance its aircraft acquisition and investment in new facilities at the new Kuala Lumpur international airport.
MAS is buying 25 aircraft from Boeing at a cost of 10 billion ringgit.

Tajudin said of the 3.271 billion ringgit to be raised, less than one billion would be set aside for its catering facility, cargo centre and engineering facility at the new airport. The remainder wil be used to part finance the aircraft purchases.
MAS will receive its first Boeing 777-200 aircraft in April and at least three other aircraft this year.
Tajudin said with this cash-raising move, he does not forsee any more such exercise until 2003.
He said the remainder for financing the plane acquisition will be met by the company's cashflow and sale of existing aircraft.
